actual_scope: An exact finite-field joint-nullity distribution for H and I-H, replacing the exponential compressed-product sum in the cited binary sharp Schur-header theorem by polynomially many explicit summands.
scope_change_reason: The explicit evaluation gap in ssafwann PR4678 motivates a scoped algebraic counting side result, rather than a formalization or predecessor audit.
bottleneck_link: Retains the shared-product rank dependence when evaluating exact one-block header frequencies. Physical implementation and supplier costs remain unknown; no new kappa.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified joint-count formula and its binary substitution; do not extend to more affine shifts or physical header covers.
evidence: PROOF.md derives the joint law and weighted substitution. verify.py checks 86727 matrices in 15 contexts, 15 weighted sums, 63 distribution consistency contexts, a new d=4 balanced evaluation and 11 controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
